newsitem.title: USA: CPT seeks Steel of W.Va. holders list.
newsitem.headline: CPT seeks Steel of W.Va. holders list.

text.p: CPT Holdings Inc said Monday it had requested a list of shareholders from Steel of West Virginia Inc in order to possibly offer them a merger deal.
CPT, the parent of J&L Structural Inc, said it asked for the list after Steel of West Virginia rejected a merger offer.
CPT said it was not deterred by the rejection.
On April 1 Steel of West Virginia described the offer as inadequate. It said CPT made the offer in February when its cyclical markets had bottomed.
Steel of West Virginia's stock closed Friday at 8-5/8.
"Quite simply, the refusal by Steel of West Virginia's board of directors even to sit down and talk about our proposed merger is a slap in the face to their shareholders," said CPT.

CPT said last week it was considering a number of actions, including acquiring shares in Steel of West Virginia, initiating a tender offer for up its shares, initiating a proxy contest, or calling for a special meeting of Steel of West Virginia shareholders in order to present its merger proposal.
J&L Structural makes lightweight structural steel shapes for the manufactured housing, truck trailer component and highway safety systems industries.
CPT is a Mentmore Holdings Corp company.
